# Slash commands

<!-- Generated by `go run ./tools/devtool gen-command-docs`. Do not edit. -->

Qompack installs seven slash commands. Each one shells out to the `qompack`
binary, so `/qompack:status` and `qompack status` are the same code and cannot
drift apart.

Every command accepts `--json`, which emits a versioned envelope instead of text,
and `--help`. Exit codes follow 00-ARCHITECTURE.md §2.3: `0` success, `2` a
malformed invocation, `1` anything else.

| Command | Subcommand | Arguments | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `/qompack:status` | `qompack status` | `[--json]` | Qompack status — mode, contracts, store, latency, last decision |
| `/qompack:recall` | `qompack recall` | `<query> [--k N]` | Search stored tool output and file versions by content |
| `/qompack:pin` | `qompack pin` | `<text>` | Pin an invariant so it is never summarized away |
| `/qompack:checkpoint` | **not yet routed** | `[--reason <text>]` | Write an immutable checkpoint now |
| `/qompack:why` | `qompack why` | `<decision-id>` | Explain a recorded decision and the evidence behind it |
| `/qompack:dropped` | `qompack dropped` | `[--json]` | Report what the last compaction dropped and how to get it back |
| `/qompack:eval` | `qompack eval` | `[--corpus <path>]` | Report the latest replay and live evaluation results |

## `/qompack:status`

Qompack status — mode, contracts, store, latency, last decision

```
qompack status — Qompack status — mode, contracts, store, latency, last decision

usage: qompack status [--json]
       /qompack:status [--json]

flags:
  --json                 emit the stable JSON envelope instead of text
```

Allowed tools: `Bash(qompack status:*)`

## `/qompack:recall`

Search stored tool output and file versions by content

```
qompack recall — Search stored tool output and file versions by content

usage: qompack recall <query> [--k N]
       /qompack:recall <query> [--k N]

flags:
  --json                 emit the stable JSON envelope instead of text
  --k <N>                return at most N results
```

Allowed tools: `Bash(qompack recall:*)`

## `/qompack:pin`

Pin an invariant so it is never summarized away

```
qompack pin — Pin an invariant so it is never summarized away

usage: qompack pin <text>
       /qompack:pin <text>

flags:
  --json                 emit the stable JSON envelope instead of text
  --list                 list the pins in scope instead of adding one
  --remove <id>          remove the pin with this id
  --source <who>         record the pin as user or agent authority (default user)
  --eliminated           record an eliminated approach instead of an invariant
  --target <text>        with --eliminated: what the approach was applied to
  --approach <text>      with --eliminated: what was tried
  --reason <text>        with --eliminated: why it did not work
  --depends-on <paths>   with --eliminated: comma-separated paths the finding rests on
  --scope <scope>        with --eliminated: session or project
```

Allowed tools: `Bash(qompack pin:*)`

## `/qompack:checkpoint`

Write an immutable checkpoint now

> **Not available in this build.** not yet reachable as a subcommand: `qompack checkpoint` is the PreCompact hook entry point, which always exits 0 and reads a hook event from stdin. A separate local-seal route needs the arch/checkpoint-now-subcommand architecture pre-step (SP-14 handoff edge H3).
>
> The help below is the surface it will present once the route exists.

```
qompack checkpoint — Write an immutable checkpoint now

usage: qompack checkpoint [--reason <text>]
       /qompack:checkpoint [--reason <text>]

flags:
  --json                 emit the stable JSON envelope instead of text
  --reason <text>        record why this checkpoint was taken
```

Allowed tools: `Bash(qompack checkpoint:*)`
